checks.text: On first load the page shows the heading "Pub trivia" and a "Start" button.
After choosing only the Ancient World category and only the Easy tier (deselecting Medium and Hard), clicking "Start" shows "Card 1 of 10".
Before revealing, the text "Answer" is not shown; clicking "Reveal answer" shows it.
After revealing, clicking "Got it" changes the score from "Score 0" to "Score 1" and shows "Card 2 of 10".
Keyboard: Space reveals, G scores a got, Space then M scores a miss; the page then shows "Card 3 of 10" and "Score 1".
Revealing and marking "Missed it" on all ten cards shows "Deck finished", a table named "Per-category results" and an enabled "Retry missed" button; clicking it starts a new deck at "Card 1 of 10".
Clicking "None" for categories shows "Choose at least one category and tier".
On the Rounds tab, clicking the first "Play" button starts a themed round showing "Card 1 of 7" or "Card 1 of 8".
The Daily question is the same after reload; answering it shows "Come back tomorrow", which persists across reload together with a "Day streak" figure.

After scoring one card and reloading, the Stats tab table "Accuracy by category" lists "Ancient World"; "Reset stats" opens a confirmation dialog, and confirming shows "Score some cards in Solo mode".
In Quizmaster mode with 2 teams, after revealing, clicking "+1 Team 1" sets it pressed (aria-pressed true) and no "Got it" button is present.
